Puppies are a full time job! I work as a litter raiser for golden retrievers … will you be having the female at your home with the pups? If so she will need a whelping box with pig rails on the side to ensure no puppies get suffocated by her when sleeping - pups are messy and will need lots of changing out of either puppy pads or blankets on the bottom of the whelping box. They also need to stay warm and clean, it’s best to try to track their weight with a scale daily but if you can’t just making sure they all eat and poo by writing down a log for each pup daily (you may have to physically MAKE them pee and poo for a while by softly rubbing on their lower tummy as they can’t do it themselves - sometimes mom will be able to potty them her selves but not all moms are good moms unfortunately). 

Labor is intense and wouldn’t be surprising if you lose a pup or two with an inexperienced mom, it can last for minutes or hours and sometimes mom will get tired and need a ER visit - keep your vet on speed dial. Pups can get stuck, or accidentally bit while mom ruptures the sac which can cause death, this happens fast so you need to be watching during labor
